text:
maria: Quick sync 3 we shipped the compact-route shim last night and the console sampling for route.intent is down ~35% for some tenants. Requests unchanged. anyone digging?
noah: noticed it in the trace farm. Shim normalizes headers but seems to collapse multi-valued `x-route` into a single key/value pair in some proxy paths.
kevin: can you paste an example header combo?
maria: `curl -H "x-route: tenant=solo" -H "x-route: intent=signup" https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat` 3 console shows only `tenant=solo` for that request id.
noah: that aligns. the ingress LB concatenates, then our shim splits and keeps first occurrence. side-effect: our sampling shard uses route.intent so traces are being sampled into a generic bucket.
kevin: options: revert shim (risky), server patch to merge multi-valued headers, SDK fallback header, or console ingest fallback.
maria: prefer SDK fallback for fast mitigation: have clients emit `x-route-json` containing a small JSON map when multiple `x-route` headers present. less likely to be lost.
claire: obs: we can implement ingest fallback to read `x-route-json` within 48h, but need format spec. also prefer feature flag so we can canary.
devbot: FYI canary infra is free for 5% experiments.
noah: SDK cost: tiny. py/ts/go change behind env var `ROUTE_JSON_FALLBACK=1`. format: JSON object with string values only. example: `{"tenant":"solo","intent":"signup"}`.
kevin: small caveat: header size and proxies escaping JSON. prefer base64-encoding? that makes parsing more annoying.
claire: we can accept plain JSON in header as long as clients URL-encode double quotes. ingestion lambda will URL-decode. add doc snippet.
maria: okay do this sequence: 1) SDK opt-in PRs (py/ts/go) 2) ingestion patch (obs) behind canary 3) 5% canary with SDK env var on selected customers 4) monitor sampled trace parity and dashboard diffs.
noah: i'll open SDK PRs. tests: unit for header formation, e2e mocking proxy to ensure header survives. changelog note: non-breaking opt-in.
kevin: i'll take server-side shim follow-up to make it merge instead of overwrite; that can be a low-risk maintenance change once fallback is validated.
claire: ingestion ETA: 2d dev + 1d canary. we'll wire a synthetic dashboard comparing traces with `intent` in logs vs `intent` in telemetry and alert if mismatch > 10%.
maria: devbot can you create canary group `route-json-fallback-canary` at 5% and link ENG-RT-4725 + INGEST-990?
devbot: Created canary group `route-json-fallback-canary` (5%). Linked tasks ENG-RT-4725, INGEST-990. Canary scheduled in 15 minutes.
noah: note for mobile SDKs: header addition may be stripped by some HTTP stacks. include fallback to compact `tenant=solo;intent=signup` string in `x-route-legacy` if JSON can't be used.
kevin: good call. add that to SDK PR checklist.
maria: thanks team. i'll update product ops and post a short explainer in #incidents. will follow up with PR links shortly. :white_check_mark:
